install: set -euo pipefail; export DOTNET_ROOT="$HOME/.dotnet" PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$HOME/.dotnet/tools:$PATH" DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 DOTNET_NOLOGO=1; touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export DOTNET_ROOT="$HOME/.dotnet"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export DOTNET_ROOT="$HOME/.dotnet"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$HOME/.dotnet/tools:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$HOME/.dotnet/tools:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; grep -qxF 'export DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; mkdir -p "$DOTNET_ROOT"; installed_sdks="$("$DOTNET_ROOT/dotnet" --list-sdks 2>/dev/null || true)"; if ! printf '%s\n' "$installed_sdks" | grep -q '^11\.0\.'; then tmp_installer="$(mktemp /tmp/dotnet-install.XXXXXX.sh)"; trap 'rm -f "$tmp_installer"' EXIT; curl -fsSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh -o "$tmp_installer"; bash "$tmp_installer" --channel 11.0 --install-dir "$DOTNET_ROOT" --no-path; rm -f "$tmp_installer"; trap - EXIT; fi; installed_tools="$(dotnet tool list --global 2>/dev/null || true)"; if ! printf '%s\n' "$installed_tools" | awk 'NR>2 {print $1 " " $2}' | grep -qx 'dotnet-ef 11\.0\.0'; then dotnet tool update --global dotnet-ef --version 11.0.0; fi; dotnet restore WebApplicationRestaurant.sln
